verdict.rationale: OpenAI maintains an official Cookbook described as 'practical code examples and patterns for APIs, agents, evals, multimodal applications, and integrations,' with its own llms.txt index. That matches a worked-examples library developers can adapt, and topic guides for agents, function calling and evals add to it. Missing for 10: no evidence that specific cookbook entries are multi-step end-to-end tasks rather than snippets (this is only implied by the description), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of how good or adaptable the examples are.
